assumptions.message: Adopted the domain 'news' with core entity Article and features: ['comments']. As specified by the domain specification, comments and discussion components are handled by the domain plugin.
Created sections enum consisting strictly of City, Business, Culture, and Sport as required.
Configured distinct areas for 'readers' (magazine view for reader role) and 'newsroom' (workspace layout for writer and editor roles).
Applied visibility policy 'readerPublishedOnly' on Article so readers and unauthenticated users only view published articles, meeting the requirement that readers only ever see published stories.
Included coverImage, excerpt, and editorFeedback fields on Article to support front-page lead presentation and editorial review feedback.

Design direction: Bookmark & Read-Later (Minimal & Direct + Demo); palette Paper warm white + ink neutral + minimal accent + tag colors; fonts Minimalist Monochrome Editorial (Playfair Display / Source Serif 4); from ui-ux-pro-max@28b3b8dee8c9
